rule: **Nothing files. All seven candidates were false splits — the first head in this run to end with an empty table.** รา is two letters, and every one of its seven senses (a joist, a mould, slackening, a hortative particle, a dual pronoun) is native and short, so the only words that begin or end in รา are Indic and Malay borrowings that happen to contain the syllable: ราหู (Pali/Skt rāhu), ราศรี (< ราศี, Skt rāśi), พารา (clipped from พาราณสี), ราคา (Malay harga from Skt अर्घ), อัตรา, ราวี — plus เพรา, one inherited morpheme with a พร- cluster, cognate with Zhuang pyaeuz. An empty filing table is a result: this head has no compound family in the corpus at all, and the nine that looked like one were noise.
